judge.rationale: The candidate accurately fixes the bug in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` by removing the `instanceof Error` gate and wrapping non-Error rejections in `new Error(String(error), {cause: error})` while rethrowing the original value untouched. It satisfies all acceptance criteria: testing string, plain object, and `undefined` rejections, preserving existing Error-instance tests unedited, updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (and line references across other spec files), and adding a migration note in `CHANGELOG.md`. Compared to the reference, the candidate uses `String(error)` directly instead of attempting `JSON.stringify` first via a `describeRejection` helper (resulting in `"[object Object]"` for plain objects even though its own DoD claimed a 'readable message'), and it leaves behind an extra `.lore/dod.md` artifact and a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file alongside the unit test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
